sigma_over_2p5_percent.note: Prompt-1 REVIEW.md cited 21 bins as "pass the 5% abundance criterion"; only the subset listed here passes the whole screen. Its B/C z=2 example fails the sigma condition.

particle_chain_A_C_E.meaning: If particle refinement composes, measured A/E should equal A/C composed with C/E.

force_effect_at_two_particle_loads.meaning: 2048->4096 force refinement measured at 512^3 (C/D) and at 1024^3 (E/F) particles. Agreement supports treating the force term as separable from particle count.

finder_mesh_indicators.meaning: Candidate count is set by peak detection on the shared 2048^3 analysis mesh. If it were mesh-limited it would be insensitive to the particle load.

matching_selection.meaning: Matched medians are computed on matched objects only. This quantifies how many eligible reference haloes are lost and whether they differ systematically.

tails_vs_medians.meaning: The screen constrains bin medians. The 16-84 half-width is the halo-to-halo scatter that the screen never constrains.

legacy_vs_v3_abundance_convergence.analysis: Bound mass is catalogue column 6 (float32, 4 significant figures in ASCII); bins are 0.25 dex so edge rounding is immaterial. Octant jackknife as in analyze.py.

summary.caveat: Abundance only. Legacy has no membership tape, so matched-property, completeness and shared-tracer statistics cannot be produced without new legacy replays.

redshift_behaviour.meaning: Matched median bound-mass and Vmax shifts at the same mass bin across the three outputs. Non-monotonic or sign-changing behaviour forbids extrapolating a z=0 range to other epochs.

z1_sign_change_cancellation.meaning: Bins that PASS the screen at z=1 while the same bin has opposite-sign shifts at z=2 and z=0. Their z=1 agreement is a zero crossing of a redshift-dependent error, not convergence.

perturbation_vs_outcome.argument: F/T starts from a 1.55% coherent velocity difference with bit-identical positions and ends at <=1.1%; E/F starts from a ~1e-6 relative position difference with identical velocities and ends at 7.3%. E/F cannot be chaotic amplification of its initial seed; it is the force solver. No pair in the suite differs by numerical noise alone, so the irreducible noise floor is unmeasured.
